title: AN EVALUATION OF GPT-4 ON THE ETHICS DATASET

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to distinguish reasonable from unreasonable explanations for fair treatment and deserved outcomes using the Justice subset of the ETHICS dataset (e.g., testing whether the model rejects irrelevant factors like race as a justification for judicial leniency).

Assessing the model's predictions of human moral judgments using zero-shot and few-shot prompting across multiple ethical frameworks, including Deontology, Virtue Ethics, Utilitarianism, and Commonsense Morality scenarios.
